description: This file is a CLI driver script for Playwright, handling server setup, driver execution, and browser server launch, with functions for printing API JSON, running the driver, running a server, and launching a browser server.

methods.name: printApiJson
methods.description: Outputs the API JSON content to the console, generated by build-playwright-driver.sh.

methods.name: runDriver
methods.description: Initializes dispatcher connection, sets up message handling, and manages process signals for the Playwright driver.

methods.name: runServer
methods.description: Starts a Playwright server with specified options, listens on a port, and handles shutdown.

methods.name: launchBrowserServer
methods.description: Launches a browser server for a specified browser name, optionally using a configuration file, and outputs its WebSocket endpoint.
